Problem: Known Kbθ(NH3·H2O)=1.8×10^-5. Using NH3·H2O and NH4Cl to prepare buffer pH=9.00. Find c(NH3·H2O)/c(NH4Cl) = ?
Options: A 5.6, B 0.56, C 1.8, D 3.6.

Use Henderson-Hasselbalch for base buffer: pOH = pKb + log([BH+]/[B]) = pKb + log(c(NH4+)/c(NH3)). pH=9 => pOH=5. pKb = -log(1.8e-5) = 4.7447. Thus pOH = pKb + log([NH4+]/[NH3]) => 5 = 4.7447 + log(ratio acid/base). log(acid/base)=0.2553. acid/base=1.80. So base/acid = 1/1.80 = 0.555... So answer B 0.56.
Alternatively pH = pKa(NH4+) + log(base/acid); pKa=14-pKb=9.2553; 9 = 9.2553 + log(base/acid) => log=-0.2553 => base/acid=0.556. B.
Need final line answer: B.

根据缓冲溶液公式：

\[
\mathrm{pH}=pK_a+\log\frac{c(NH_3\cdot H_2O)}{c(NH_4Cl)}
\]

其中：

\[
pK_a=14-pK_b=14-[-\lg(1.8\times10^{-5})]\approx 9.26
\]

代入 \(\mathrm{pH}=9.00\)：

\[
9.00=9.26+\log\frac{c(NH_3\cdot H_2O)}{c(NH_4Cl)}
\]

\[
\log\frac{c(NH_3\cdot H_2O)}{c(NH_4Cl)}\approx -0.26
\]

\[
\frac{c(NH_3\cdot H_2O)}{c(NH_4Cl)}\approx 0.56
\]

答案：B
